# Prism

> Prism builds your application into a holo, a content-addressed package that carries its own proof and provenance, and checks them before anything runs.

## Get started

- [Prism docs](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/): Build applications that prove what they do, then check, run and ship them anywhere.
- [What Prism is](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/get-started/introduction): Prism explained in Docker terms, with every noun and verb side by side.
- [Quickstart](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/get-started/quickstart): Scaffold, build, check, run and deploy your first holo in five minutes.
- [Core concepts](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/get-started/core-concepts): The seven ideas behind every Prism command, each with one example.

## Concepts

- [The holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/concepts/holo): Why a Prism application is one self-describing file, and what that file holds.
- [Proof and assurance](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/concepts/proof-and-assurance): What a proof adds to tests, how assurance levels measure evidence, and where the guarantee stops.
- [World and capabilities](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/concepts/world-and-capabilities): Why a holo declares what it needs, and why it gets nothing until something grants it.
- [Provenance and attestations](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/concepts/provenance-and-attestations): How a holo records where it came from, and how a signature ties that record to someone.
- [Reproducible builds](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/concepts/reproducible-builds): How the SDK image and the lockfile make the same inputs produce the same holo.
- [Registries and releases](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/concepts/registries-and-releases): Why holos use the registries you already run, and how a digest keeps them honest there.

## Guides

- [Write from examples](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/guides/write-from-examples): Author an application from examples, intent and types, build it, and read the report.
- [Develop with the studio](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/guides/dev-studio): Watch the model, rebuild and re-check on every save, and read the verdict in a local studio that works offline.
- [Verify and inspect](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/guides/verify-and-inspect): Check a holo against a policy, read the verdict, and look inside without running it.
- [Run a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/guides/run-a-holo): One run of a holo is a container, with a state, an exit code and its output, kept until you remove it.
- [Run and gate](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/guides/run-and-gate): Run a checked holo with exactly its capability set, and decide what happens when the check fails.
- [Write a middleware](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/guides/write-a-middleware): Add your own code around the steps the runtime performs, and trace each step with OpenTelemetry.
- [Ship a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/guides/ship): Push and pull holos through any registry, publish to GitHub Pages, and export for Docker.
- [Rebuild and update](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/guides/rebuild-and-update): Reproduce a pinned build, confirm its digest, and move a pin forward on purpose.
- [Use with agents](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/guides/agents): Give an agent a holo as a tool, serve it over MCP, or let an agent write the model.
- [Audit a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/guides/audit): Read the security view of a holo, export the report, and know exactly what the proof covers.
- [Write the model](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/guides/write-the-model): Write the model files yourself when examples and intent are not enough.

## Examples

- [Call a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/examples/call-a-holo): Load the sample holo, send it one request and replay its examples from JavaScript.
- [From the command line](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/examples/command-line): Replay a holo's examples and read what it says about itself with the prism-code command.
- [Replay examples](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/examples/replay-examples): Run every example a holo carries and count how many still give the expected answer.
- [Inspect a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/examples/inspect-a-holo): List the sections of a holo from code, without running it.
- [Check a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/examples/check-a-holo): Judge a holo against a policy from code, and handle the error when it falls short.
- [Read the spec package](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/examples/read-the-spec): Read the format revision and other constants a tool needs from the spec package.

## Reference

- [Holo format](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/holo-format): The byte layout of a .holo file, its sections, digests and format revisions.
- [Attestations reference](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/attestations): The statement and envelope a holo's attestations use, the predicate types and their status.
- [Manifest reference](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/manifest): Every table and key in prism.toml.
- [Lockfile reference](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/lockfile): Every field of the lockfile, from the schema the spec package publishes.
- [Errors reference](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/errors): Every error code the runtime raises and every CLI exit code.
- [CLI reference](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/cli): The prism-code command that ships today, then every prism verb, its flags, its exit codes and its usage.
- [Policy reference](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/policy): The policy check and run judge a holo against, the default policy and how a failure is reported.
- [Release status](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/reference/release-status): What you can use today and which release each Prism feature lands in.

## API Reference

- [prism-code at a glance](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api): Load a holo, dispatch an input and replay its examples from Node.js with the prism-code runtime.
- [Load a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/load): Read a holo from a path, a URL or bytes and get an application you can inspect and run.
- [Inspect a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/inspect): Read the manifest, digests, world and attestations of a holo without running it.
- [Check a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/verify): Check digest, provenance, proof and world against a policy and get a verdict.
- [Instantiate a holo](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/instantiate): Create a running instance with exactly the capability set you grant.
- [Dispatch inputs](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/dispatch): Send one request to the holo and get its response.
- [History and replay](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/history-and-replay): Replay the examples a holo carries and prove its behaviour unchanged.
- [Use a holo as a tool](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/as-tool): Wrap a checked holo as a Vercel AI SDK tool so a model can call it.
- [Error types](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/errors): Every error the runtime throws and the code it carries.
- [Spec package](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/spec-package): The types, JSON Schemas, world file and format revision that every runtime is built from.
- [Check in the browser](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/verify-package): Check a holo offline in any browser without loading the runtime.
- [Testing package](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/api/testing-package): Test code that drives a holo with a mock host, skipped time and scripted dispatch.

## SDKs

- [SDK overview](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/sdks/overview): The runtime for each language, where it is published, its stability tier and the one spec they share.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/sdks/typescript): Install prism-code from npm and run a holo from Node.js or the browser.
- [Rust SDK](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/sdks/rust): Add the prism-code crate and run a holo from Rust.
- [Python SDK](https://universal-coordinate-foundation.lovable.app/docs/sdks/python): Install prism-code from PyPI and run a holo from Python.
